name: Perseverance Expedition
dateMethod: Approximate UTC calendar equivalent: landing epoch plus mean sol (88775.244 seconds). Inter-leg sols are editorial progress, not exact historical positions.
routeMethod: Edited one-way landmark tour: direct terrain-checked connections, rounded corners and separate return lanes. Intermediate historical driving reversals are omitted. Historical trace is research only.

recovery.policy: Capture last safe grounded pose on active leg before crossing its corridor. Re-entry cancels warning. Lift back to captured pose, preserving progress; use preceding approved recovery point if pose unsafe.

checkpoints.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
checkpoints.fact: Perseverance landed on 18 February 2021. Its first investigations explored Jezero’s crater floor.
checkpoints.positionEvidence: Regional tour stop based on a pinned rover-area waypoint; arrival may use a separate parallel lane. Chapter name is not a surveyed feature centroid.

checkpoints.name: Séítah · rocks among sand
checkpoints.fact: Early crater-floor investigations found igneous rocks: material formed as molten rock cooled. Water later altered some minerals.

checkpoints.name: Delta front approach

checkpoints.name: Three Forks · sample depot
